name: Lara Bay
description: A protected sand bay on the west of the Akamas where loggerhead and green turtles nest between June and September. There are no sunbeds, no bar and no road worth the name, which is the arrangement that keeps the turtles.
getting: Dirt track north from Agios Georgios, 40 minutes, and a 4x4 is genuinely the right vehicle. Nesting areas are fenced and stay closed at night.
